headline: Temporary approval for a free little pantry at Shedd Park, plus fee waivers for a Lowell High bake sale and a bike race.
summary: A $150 credit for a canceled Shedd Park event was approved, and the fee for a bike race that will not happen this year was waived. Talk also covered permit no-shows, a possible change to Finn Field, and whether to allow Zoom attendance at meetings.
decisions: Gave temporary approval for a free little pantry at Shedd Park until other departments approve it.
Approved a $150 credit toward fees owed for a canceled September 26 event at Shedd Park.
Waived the fee for a November 22 bike race at Shedd Park.
Approved the Lowell High bake sale at Shedd Park on November 8 with no fee.
discussion: Shedd Park permit no-shows: Members discussed people who book dates and do not attend the meeting, and said there is no deposit system and no easy way to track it.
Finn Field conversion: Members questioned a plan to turn Finn Field into a multi-purpose baseball and softball field, and said it is expected back in January.
North Common unpermitted play: Members said a league plays on the North Common field without a permit, and that the city has no staff to check permits at every field.
Zoom attendance for meetings: A member asked to allow Zoom so a quorum can be reached when members are late. Others said in-person attendance is important and that setup is hard.
Outstanding permit fees: Staff reviewed unpaid fees for this year, with some waived tonight and groups usually paying by the end of December.
